method.method_draft: Start from the image and trace every non-H connection: the left phenyl ring contributes 6 bond connections, then follow the linker through the aryl–carbonyl connection, the carbonyl C–O connection, the carbonyl-to-CH2 connection, the CH2–N connection, and the N–phenyl connection, then add the 6 bond connections around the right phenyl ring.
